answers.M6-S1: People will always believe anything to get what they want, and you should never trust anyone who offers you magic.
answers.M6-S2: Because if people found out, everyone would want the seed and Billy would run out, so the secret keeps it working only for him and the narrator.
answers.M6-S3: The narrator thinks Billy is being a true friend giving him real magic, but the reader knows Billy is a liar who tricks everybody for money.
answers.M6-S4: He was terrified he would be the shortest person forever, just like Uncle Alec, and would do anything at all to grow tall.
answers.M6-S5: To make the seed seem really powerful and dangerous, and so the narrator can never check or get more from anyone except Billy.
answers.M6-S6: It shows the seed does not work at all and the narrator will never grow, but he still keeps believing it.
answers.M6-S7: To prove the magic seed really works, since Billy grew taller than everyone because of it.
answers.M6-S8: That everyone in town hated Billy because he was mean and dishonest to all of them.
answers.M6-S9: He loved his uncle but thought being short was terrible and didn't want to end up like him at all.
